displayName: OCI-AI-DB-031: AI — Knowledge Graph Manipulation Attack
description:
Detects manipulation of knowledge graphs used by AI systems for reasoning and entity resolution

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_031", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%knowledge%' AND "value" > 0
